falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4200 at any point in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the bottom pattern match, as the structure would no longer resemble a completed bottom formation and instead suggest continuation of the prior downtrend

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal panic-level volatility inconsistent with a bottoming pattern; the 2024 August bottom featured VIX peaking near 28 and rapidly declining, so sustained extreme fear would break the pattern structure

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further by more than 25bps from current levels (deeper inversion)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A worsening yield curve inversion would indicate escalating recession risk rather than the stabilization typical of a market bottom; the August 2024 bottom coincided with curve steepening/un-inversion, so deepening inversion breaks the macro setup

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
